paper_title: I Don't Know Explicit Modeling of Uncertainty with an [IDK] Token
caption: : Tradeoff between and for different parameter combinations. We annotate each data point with its corresponding value.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the tradeoff between IDK error rate and IDK recall for different parameter combinations. The x-axis represents IDK error rate, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.25, and tick labels at regular intervals of 0.05. The y-axis represents IDK recall, with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 0.6, and tick labels at regular intervals of 0.1. The plot contains four lines: a blue line with circle markers and a solid line style, an orange line with circle markers and a solid line style, a green line with triangle markers and a dashed line style, and a red line with triangle markers and a dashed line style. The blue line starts at approximately (0, 0.1) and increases to (0.25, 0.6). The orange line starts at approximately (0, 0.1) and increases to (0.22, 0.5). The green line starts at approximately (0, 0.15) and increases to (0.22, 0.5). The red line starts at approximately (0, 0.3) and increases to (0.12, 0.6).
